messages:
alex-support: Hey @mike-oncall @sara-eng — we just started getting a handful of customer reports of 429s for tenants on Dedicated after a plan change around 12:05 UTC. Tenant tenant_42 impacted first, then a few others in d-pool-us-east-1a. Error seen in customer logs: `tenant_rate_limit_exceeded`. Can oncall investigate?

ops-bot: alert: dedicated-pool-d-pool-us-east-1a high-429-rate detected (5m avg). linked incidents: INC-2026-3012

mike-oncall: investigating now. pulling quota config + rate-limiter metric for tenant_42. any recent infra deploys?

sara-eng: no infra deploys to serving runtime at that time. There was a tenant plan migration job that bumped plan -> "growth" at 12:04:53 UTC. Suspect migration updated quota fields.

mike-oncall: grabbing quota:```http
GET /api/internal/tenants/tenant_42/quota
{
  "tenant_id": "tenant_42",
  "plan": "growth",
  "qps": 10,
  "rate_units_per_minute": 0,
  "burst": 50
}
```Looks like rate_units_per_minute is 0 — that's not right. Rate limiter treats 0 as immediate deny in the runtime path. That would explain the 429s.

jen-ml: hmm that field should be set by the billing/plan mapper. Maybe a change in the migration script left it unset for "growth". Could also be a default fallback bug.

alex-support: reproduction from our side (small load test) returned 429 immediately:```bash
for i in {1..20}; do 
  curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-llama-gt-1","input":"hi"}' -w "\n%{http_code}\n"
done
# -> many lines with 429
```Response body: `{"error":"tenant_rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":60}`

mike-oncall: temporary mitigation: set rate_units_per_minute -> 600 and restart limiter for tenant. Patching now.```http
PATCH /api/internal/tenants/tenant_42/quota
{ "rate_units_per_minute": 600 }
```Patched at 12:12:05 UTC. Restarted per-tenant limiter slice.

sara-eng: checking autoscaler events — autoscaler didn't scale because policy looked at avg_qps, and qps=10 is under threshold. So even though the tenant needed more tokens, autoscaler wasn't triggered. Two separate mismatches: plan mapping left rate_units zero, autoscaler gating is on qps not token bucket.

jen-ml: noisy neighbor ruled out for tenant_42 — no abnormal GPU saturation in d-pool-us-east-1a, but there were two other tenants with heavy burst in same pool earlier which increased overall queueing. That made the zero-rate condition visible sooner.

alex-support: customers reporting success for new calls but one mentioned a few failed attempts still — likely clients retry with low backoff.

mike-oncall: rolling fix: 1) applied immediate patch for affected tenants with rate_units=0 -> set to plan-default 600 2) added detection rule to alerts when rate_units_per_minute==0 for active tenants 3) opened eng ticket to validate plan-migration job and add migration safety checks.

sara-eng: putting actionable items in ENG board: - #ENG-1234 add server-side validation on plan change (reject or auto-fill required quota fields) - #ENG-1235 update autoscaler policy to consider token-bucket exhaustion metric - #ENG-1236 backfill migration for tenants updated between 2026-03-15 00:00 and 2026-03-17 18:00 (suspect window)

ops-bot: incident update: mitigation applied, degraded->recovering. Poke channel if customers still see errors. :white_check_mark:

alex-support: thanks team. I'll notify affected customers and include repro details + ETA for permanent fix. :pray:
